messages.subject: R813 report completed
messages.body: Wrote the 1,787-word read-only report and pinned seven primary source files to immutable revisions with matching local hashes. It compares grouped scheduling, small-M policies, bounded dequant residency, and fused epilogues; 512 experts' FP16 weights are 4.6875 GiB per layer, while actual fit, quality, and performance remain unmeasured. No build, test, GPU, profiler, process inspection, R810 package access, or XeStrata material was used; review and any implementation qualification remain with Main.
